Package de.labathome.trustconstr.report

Class SQPReport

java.lang.Object
de.labathome.trustconstr.report.ReportBase
de.labathome.trustconstr.report.SQPReport
public class SQPReport extends ReportBase
Equality-constrained SQP progress report (9 columns). Counterpart to scipy's _trustregion_constr/report.py:SQPReport.

Columns: niter | f evals | CG iter | obj func | tr radius | opt | c viol | penalty | CG stop.
